description: Permanently delete one memory and its incident graph edges by ID (destructive, idempotent; consumes 1 Write API call) and return { deleted }. Enforces organization ownership (returns JSON-RPC error -32003 on foreign IDs) and returns { deleted: false } when the ID is already absent. Use when removing a single known memory ID; use delete_by_context instead to bulk-delete memories by [key, value] metadata tag, or feedback (useful=false) to lower salience without deleting.

id.description: Exact memory UUID returned by encode_memory or recall_memories.

name: forget_memory

deleted.description: True if an existing memory was removed, false if already absent.

title: Forget Memory
